response: Fine-tuning GPT-2 involves several steps. First, prepare your dataset by cleaning and formatting the text. Then, install the necessary libraries and load the GPT-2 model. Use the `transformers` library from Hugging Face, which provides a convenient way to fine-tune the model. You can do this by creating a `Trainer` object and specifying the training arguments. Finally, train the model on your dataset and evaluate its performance.
